decisions.disposition_history: April16,2025BoardSpecialOrder7A unanimously removesJoeOrtonfromSecurityTeam. Reason unstated. This is notJoeSchaefer,notHTTPDPMCremoval,andnotrevocationofHTTPDcommitterrights.
decisions.eligibility_reason: The April16resolution removes Joe Orton from the central Security Team. It does not name HTTPD as a recipient or alter HTTPD PMC, committer or chair rights. His separate HTTPD affiliation alone is insufficient under the registered actor-capacity rule. Retain the formal central-role event as context; exclude it as a selected PMC–Foundation episode. This is a different person from Joe Schaefer.
decisions.source_scope: Only the identified Board resolution/officer/cohort report establishes the stated act. Other content in the complete retained minutes is context, not an independent confirmation.

context_exclusions.reason: Dated names/counts support historical actor-role checks. A project report of a private routine admission or departure does not itself expose a public proposal for binding overall governance change or a Foundation act naming that project. Do not turn the authority-roster source into a new outcome frame. Formal Board appointments/removals naming selected PMCs and public shared-service requests are separately retained.

limits: Observed institutional capacity, rather than personal cross-affiliation, controls inclusion. No private membership process or hidden project intervention reconstructed.
